Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information visit
Texts.Tracker:ActivityTimeRangeInvalid: The activity's end time must be after its start time.
Texts.Tracker:ActivityClientIdRequired: The activity must carry the client-generated activity id (idempotency key).
Texts.Tracker:ActivityClientIdConflict: This client activity id is already used by another member.
Texts.Tracker:ActivityInFuture: The activity ends in the future. Check the device clock.
Texts.Tracker:ActivityTooLong: The activity lasts {durationMinutes} minutes, longer than the {maxMinutes}-minute maximum for this project.
Texts.Tracker:ActivityTooOld: The activity started too long ago and can no longer be recorded.
Texts.Tracker:ActivityOverlaps: The activity overlaps time you have already tracked.
Texts.Tracker:ProjectArchived: The project is archived; time can no longer be tracked against it.
Texts.Tracker:NotProjectMember: You are not a member of this project.
Texts.Tracker:DuplicateProjectMember: This user is already a member of the project.
Texts.Tracker:InvalidCaptureData: The uploaded capture is not valid base64 image data.
Texts.Tracker:CaptureTooLarge: The uploaded capture exceeds the maximum allowed size.
Texts.Tracker:SubscriptionInactive: The workspace subscription is not active. Ask the workspace owner to renew it.
Texts.Tracker:PlanNotFound: The requested plan does not exist.
Texts.Tracker:PlanInUse: The plan cannot be deleted while subscriptions still use it.
Texts.Tracker:SeatLimitReached: Your plan's seat limit has been reached. Upgrade the plan to add more members.
Texts.Tracker:ReportRangeInvalid: The report range must end after it starts and span at most {maxDays} days.
Texts.Tracker:InvalidUser: The user does not exist in this workspace.
Texts.Tracker:CannotModifySelf: You cannot make this change to your own account or membership.
Texts.Tracker:RoleNotAllowed: Only the workspace owner can grant this role, change hourly rates or manage an owner's account.
Texts.Tracker:WorkspaceRequired: Choose a workspace: send its id in the X-Workspace-Id header.
Texts.Tracker:WorkspaceArchived: This workspace is archived. Contact a workspace owner to restore it.
Texts.Tracker:NotWorkspaceMember: You are not a member of this workspace.
Texts.Tracker:EmailAlreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists. Sign in and create the workspace from inside the app.
Texts.Tracker:DuplicateWorkspaceName: A workspace with this name already exists.
Texts.Tracker:LastOwnerCannotLeave: You are the workspace's last owner. Make someone else an owner before leaving.
Texts.Tracker:InvitationExpired: This invitation has expired or was already used.
Texts.Tracker:InvitationEmailMismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
Texts.Tracker:AlreadyWorkspaceMember: This person is already a member of the workspace.
Texts.Tracker:EmailNotConfirmed: Verify your email address first, or open the invitation link you were sent.
Texts.Tracker:ExportExceedsLimit: The requested export exceeds the maximum limit of {limit} records (found {totalCount}). Please narrow your date range or filters.
Texts.Tracker:DeviceRevoked: This computer was removed from this workspace and was signed out. Ask a workspace owner or manager to restore it to track time here again.
Texts.Tracker:DeviceNotObserved: This device has never been seen for this member in this workspace.
Texts.Tracker:DeviceNotFound: This device is not revoked in this workspace.
Texts.Tracker:DeviceIdRequired: The request names no device: sign in with a device_id, or send the agent's deviceId.
Texts.Tracker:ActivityDeleted: This time block was deleted from the workspace and cannot be uploaded again.
Texts.Tracker:CaptureDeleteNotAllowed: You can delete your own captures only for {windowMinutes} minutes after they were uploaded. Ask a workspace owner or manager to delete it.
Texts.Tracker:WorkspaceDeleteConfirmationMisma: Type the workspace's name exactly to confirm its deletion.
Texts.Tracker:SoleWorkspaceOwner: You are the only owner of {workspaces}. Make someone else an owner or delete the workspace before deleting your account.
Texts.Tracker:AccountDeletionNotAllowed: A platform administrator's account cannot be deleted here.
Texts.Tracker:EmailConfirmationInvalid: This email confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
Texts.Tracker:BillingDisabled: Billing is turned off on this server: every workspace is active and has no plan to change.
Texts.Tracker:PlanChangeNotAllowed: Owners can switch to a free plan themselves. Contact support to change to a paid plan.
Texts.Tracker:AiNotConfigured: AI assist isn't available on this server.
Texts.Tracker:AiPlatformDisabled: AI assist is turned off for the platform right now.
Texts.Tracker:AiDisabled: AI assist is off for this workspace.
Texts.Tracker:AiFeatureDisabled: This AI feature isn't available to you.
Texts.Tracker:AiQuotaExceeded: The AI allowance for this period has been used. It renews on {resetsAt}.
Texts.Tracker:AiRateLimited: Too many AI requests. Try again in {retryAfterSeconds} seconds.
Texts.Tracker:AiProviderUnavailable: The AI service is slow or unavailable. Try again in a minute.
Texts.Tracker:AiOutputInvalid: The AI couldn't produce a reliable answer. Try again.
Texts.Tracker:AiRangeTooLarge: Choose {maxDays} days or fewer for AI summaries.
Texts.Tracker:AiDisclosureNotAccepted: Review and accept the AI disclosure (version {version}) to turn on AI assist.
Texts.Tracker:AiConversationExpired: This conversation ended. Start a new one.
Texts.AiAssist:Disclaimer: AI-generated from your tracker data. Figures come from the tracker; the wording can be wrong - check before acting. Not for decisions about people on its own.
